engineering_scope.note: Full fixed grammar supports L1–L4. Engineering cost does not necessarily grow steeply for these finite templates.

audit.counterfactual_design: Two different uniquely specified targets per identical scene; target is not marked. Any deterministic no-text policy has <=50% success on each complete paired split.
audit.behind_definition: higher image y-direction: target y < anchor y - 0.06 (top-down screen coordinates)
audit.between_definition: projection within (0.15,0.85) of anchor segment, perpendicular distance <0.10 normalized workspace
